lines.zh: 象群走得很慢，柏油坑也拦不住。
lines.en: The herd moves slowly; even tar pits do not stop us.

lines.zh: 我踩碎枯枝，幼崽紧跟在我腹下。
lines.en: I crush dry branches while the calf walks beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 传说维度的沙地上，我的脚印最深。
lines.en: In Precasia's sand, my footprints sink the deepest.

lines.zh: 树叶在树冠上，我伸长鼻子去够。
lines.en: Leaves hang high; I stretch my trunk to reach them.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，不用着急。
lines.en: One of my steps covers three of yours, so no hurry.

lines.zh: 森林边那条小路，是我们踩出来的。
lines.en: The path by the forest edge was worn by our feet.

lines.zh: 草叶划过我的膝盖，我不在意。
lines.en: Grass brushes my knees and I hardly notice.

lines.zh: 幼崽学我甩鼻子，甩得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: The calf copies my trunk swing and gets it crooked.

lines.zh: 我从热带草原走向更绿的坡地。
lines.en: I leave the savanna for a greener slope.

lines.zh: 象群里年长的那头走在最前面。
lines.en: The oldest of the herd walks at the very front.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥沼，不是怕，是嫌脏。
lines.en: I step around the mire, not from fear but distaste.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜很凉，我们挤成一堵墙。
lines.en: Desert nights turn cold, so we press into a wall.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子能卷起一整捆嫩枝。
lines.en: My trunk can curl around a whole bundle of shoots.

lines.zh: 别站在我脚边，我看不见那么低。
lines.en: Do not stand by my feet; I cannot see that low.

lines.zh: 我嚼着树叶，听见远处的雷。
lines.en: I chew leaves and listen to distant thunder.

lines.zh: 幼崽靠着我打盹，我不敢动。
lines.en: The calf dozes against me, so I hold still.

lines.zh: 九十五点血肉，也够我站很久。
lines.en: Ninety-five points of flesh keep me standing a long while.

lines.zh: 柏油坑冒泡，像谁在下面叹气。
lines.en: The tar pit bubbles as if something sighs below.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起一团尘土，撒在背上。
lines.en: I scoop dust with my trunk and throw it on my back.

lines.zh: 树叶的汁水顺着嘴角往下滴。
lines.en: Leaf sap drips down the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我记不清昨天走过哪片林子。
lines.en: I cannot recall which grove I crossed yesterday.

lines.zh: 传说维度的风带着一点甜味。
lines.en: The wind of Precasia carries a faint sweetness.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵扇动，赶走看不见的虫。
lines.en: My ears flap to chase off invisible insects.

lines.zh: 象群安静下来，只剩咀嚼声。
lines.en: The herd falls quiet; only chewing remains.

lines.zh: 我靠着一棵老树，树皮被我蹭亮。
lines.en: I lean on an old tree until its bark shines.

lines.zh: 远处那头象抬头，我们就都抬头。
lines.en: One elephant looks up, and we all look up.

lines.zh: 我记得每一处水洼的位置。
lines.en: I remember the place of every water hole.

lines.zh: 站久了，我的膝盖发出闷响。
lines.en: Standing too long, my knees give a muffled creak.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起一根枝条，慢慢扯。
lines.en: My trunk wraps a branch and pulls it slowly.

lines.zh: 油沙把蹄子陷住，我换只脚。
lines.en: Tar sand traps a hoof, so I shift feet.

lines.zh: 幼崽跑远了半步，我又等它回来。
lines.en: The calf strays half a step. I wait for it.

lines.zh: 这片林子的叶子，我挑软的吃。
lines.en: In this wood I pick only the soft leaves.

lines.zh: 你比我的幼崽还小，却敢靠近。
lines.en: You are smaller than my calf, yet you come close.

lines.zh: 你的手里没有树叶，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Your hands hold no leaves, so I lose interest.

lines.zh: 我弯下脖子，眼睛才够得着你。
lines.en: I bend my neck so my eyes can reach you.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像火，不像草地。
lines.en: You smell of fire, not of grass.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的象牙，它只是弯的。
lines.en: Do not stare at my tusks; they are merely curved.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我的眼睛发涩。
lines.en: You raise a torch and my eyes begin to sting.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰间的剑，也看见你在抖。
lines.en: I see the blade at your waist, and see you shaking.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好挡着幼崽的路。
lines.en: You are standing right where my calf wants to pass.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手上有浆果的甜气。
lines.en: I smell berry sweetness on your fingers.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我就把头转回去。
lines.en: Step back a little and I will turn away.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我鼻尖上，很轻。
lines.en: Your shadow settles on my trunk, very light.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才想起该吃草。
lines.en: I watch you a long time before recalling to graze.

lines.zh: 这一刀划破皮，血慢慢渗出来。
lines.en: The blade parts my hide and blood seeps out slowly.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，林子里的鸟全飞了。
lines.en: I bellow once and every bird in the grove flees.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我鼻子里冒气。
lines.en: That blow makes steam snort from my trunk.

lines.zh: 你砍中的地方，是幼崽看不见的那侧。
lines.en: You struck the side the calf cannot see.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，象牙还是朝着你。
lines.en: I back two steps, tusks still pointed at you.

lines.zh: 这身皮厚，你的剑卷了刃。
lines.en: This hide is thick; your sword has dulled.

lines.zh: 我撞断了一棵树，只因为疼。
lines.en: I broke a tree in half, only from pain.

lines.zh: 别站在我甩头的范围里。
lines.en: Do not stand within reach of my swinging head.

lines.zh: 血滴在草上，幼崽闻到了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the grass and the calf smells it.

lines.zh: 你要么现在走，要么被我踩。
lines.en: Either leave now or be trampled underfoot.

lines.zh: 你举着树叶，那我就跟你走一段。
lines.en: Hold out leaves and I will follow you a while.

lines.zh: 这一把嫩枝，比整片林子都香。
lines.en: This bundle of shoots smells better than the whole forest.

lines.zh: 我不急，你把叶子举稳一点。
lines.en: No rush; just hold those leaves steady.

lines.zh: 为了一口吃的，我可以走得很远。
lines.en: For one mouthful I would walk a long way.

lines.zh: 幼崽也想吃，你多准备一些。
lines.en: The calf wants some too, so bring more.

lines.zh: 树叶在你手里，比在树上有吸引力。
lines.en: Leaves in your hand tempt me more than on the tree.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃枝条，我的鼻子就跟过去。
lines.en: Wave a branch and my trunk follows it.

lines.zh: 我闻到青草味，脚步就自己转了向。
lines.en: I smell fresh grass and my feet turn on their own.

lines.zh: 你走慢些，我这体重刹不住。
lines.en: Slow down; this much weight cannot stop quickly.

lines.zh: 吃完这一口，我可就不认你了。
lines.en: Once this mouthful is gone, I forget you again.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会像叶子一样弹开。
lines.en: Bump into me and you bounce off like a leaf.

lines.zh: 我停下脚步，是给你让路。
lines.en: I stop walking to let you go first.

lines.zh: 我的肩比你的门还宽。
lines.en: My shoulder is wider than your door.

lines.zh: 你从我腿间穿过去，小心象牙。
lines.en: Pass between my legs, but mind the tusks.

lines.zh: 这么一碰，我的皮都没感觉。
lines.en: That little bump did not even reach my hide.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我就挪开了。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow, so I shifted aside.

lines.zh: 别推，我这身肉可不是门。
lines.en: Do not shove; this bulk is not a door.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两堵会走的墙。
lines.en: We collide like two walls that happen to walk.

lines.zh: 你弹回来的样子，让幼崽笑了。
lines.en: The way you rebound made the calf laugh.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，柏油坑就在你后面。
lines.en: I step aside; the tar pit is right behind you.

lines.zh: 我低下额头，轻轻碰了碰她的。
lines.en: I lower my brow and gently touch hers.

lines.zh: 她走在前面，我替她挡着风。
lines.en: She walks ahead while I block the wind for her.

lines.zh: 象群围着我们，慢慢绕圈。
lines.en: The herd circles us slowly, round and round.

lines.zh: 我卷起一束花，放在她脚边。
lines.en: I curl up a bunch of flowers and lay it at her feet.

lines.zh: 我们肩挨着肩，只听得见呼吸。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, we hear only breathing.

lines.zh: 她的耳朵贴着我，像一片暖叶。
lines.en: Her ear rests against me like a warm leaf.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子替她拂开背上的虫。
lines.en: I brush the insects from her back with my trunk.

lines.zh: 这一片草地，够我们两个吃。
lines.en: This meadow is enough for the two of us.

lines.zh: 幼崽在旁边转，假装没在看。
lines.en: The calf wanders nearby, pretending not to look.

lines.zh: 我们走得慢，所以才走得久。
lines.en: We walk slowly, and that is why we last.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷起果子，放进嘴里。
lines.en: I curl my trunk around a fruit and eat it.

lines.zh: 这枚亮东西不能吃，我放下了。
lines.en: This shiny thing is not food, so I put it down.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比手指笨，掉了两次。
lines.en: My trunk is clumsier than fingers; I dropped it twice.

lines.zh: 你扔下的面包，被幼崽抢走了。
lines.en: The calf snatched the bread you threw down.

lines.zh: 我卷起一根树枝，随手折成两段。
lines.en: I pick up a branch and snap it in two.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，我的鼻子夹不住。
lines.en: This thing is too small for my trunk to grip.

lines.zh: 我把石头挪开，下面有一窝甲虫。
lines.en: I move a stone and uncover a nest of beetles.

lines.zh: 捡东西这活，幼崽比我灵巧。
lines.en: At picking things up, the calf is nimbler than me.

lines.zh: 我卷起你的帽子，还给你。
lines.en: I curl up your hat and give it back.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的嫩芽，我一根都不浪费。
lines.en: Not one shoot on the ground goes to waste.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近幼崽，我抬起头。
lines.en: Something nears the calf, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁锈和皮革的味道。
lines.en: I smell iron rust and cured leather.

lines.zh: 灌木在动，我朝那边转过身。
lines.en: The bushes move, and I turn that way.

lines.zh: 这个声音我听过，是猎人。
lines.en: I have heard that sound before; it is a hunter.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵先转向，眼睛慢一步。
lines.en: My ears turn first; my eyes arrive a step later.

lines.zh: 幼崽躲到我身后，这就够了。
lines.en: The calf hides behind me, and that settles it.

lines.zh: 谁在树后吸气，我听见了。
lines.en: Whoever breathes behind that tree, I hear it.

lines.zh: 我不管你是谁，离象群远些。
lines.en: I do not care who you are; stay from the herd.

lines.zh: 远处有鼓点，我的鼻子抬起来。
lines.en: Drums sound far off and my trunk lifts.

lines.zh: 我盯住那道影子，直到它不动。
lines.en: I fix on that shadow until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 我的目光黏在你身上，挪不开。
lines.en: My gaze sticks to you and will not shift.

lines.zh: 你往左走，我的头就往左转。
lines.en: You step left, and my head turns left.

lines.zh: 我在等你把剑收起来。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to sheathe that blade.

lines.zh: 象群已经围成半个圈。
lines.en: The herd has already formed half a ring.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我的鼻子就扬高一点。
lines.en: Every time you move, my trunk rises a little higher.

lines.zh: 我不冲，我只是不让你过去。
lines.en: I do not charge; I simply will not let you pass.

lines.zh: 你退到那棵树边，我就停下。
lines.en: Back up to that tree and I will stop.

lines.zh: 幼崽在我腿后，你看见了吧。
lines.en: The calf stands behind my legs; you see it.

lines.zh: 这一片草地，我们不打算让。
lines.en: We do not intend to give up this meadow.

lines.zh: 你的手一抖，我就知道你要动手。
lines.en: Your hand twitches, and I know what comes next.

lines.zh: 我用额头撞过去，你自己站稳。
lines.en: I drive my brow forward; steady yourself.

lines.zh: 象牙只是抬了一下，你就退了。
lines.en: My tusks only lifted once, and you retreated.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩下去，地面都在响。
lines.en: I bring my foot down and the ground rings.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，比砍我十下更疼。
lines.en: One shove from me hurts more than ten cuts.

lines.zh: 别逼我把整个身体压过去。
lines.en: Do not make me lean this whole body on you.

lines.zh: 我甩头，象牙划出一道风声。
lines.en: I swing my head and the tusks whistle past.

lines.zh: 幼崽在叫，我就不会再留手。
lines.en: The calf is calling, so I stop holding back.

lines.zh: 你砍在我背上，只留下一道白痕。
lines.en: Your blade left only a pale line on my back.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，不是要追。
lines.en: I knock you aside; I am not chasing.

lines.zh: 八点力道，对一头象来说很轻。
lines.en: Eight points of force is light for an elephant.

lines.zh: 柏油坑边，象群从雾里走出来。
lines.en: By the tar pit, the herd steps out of the mist.

lines.zh: 我带着幼崽，落在传说维度的草地上。
lines.en: I arrive with my calf on Precasia's grass.

lines.zh: 沙丘后面传来低沉的脚步声。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps come from behind the dunes.

lines.zh: 三头象一起出现，草地塌了一片。
lines.en: Three elephants appear at once and the grass flattens.

lines.zh: 我从林子里挤出来，撞掉一层树叶。
lines.en: I squeeze from the woods and shake down a canopy.

lines.zh: 这里的树够高，叶子也够嫩。
lines.en: The trees here are tall and the leaves tender.

lines.zh: 我出生的地方，有一片黑色的坑。
lines.en: Where I was born there was a black pit.

lines.zh: 热带草原的风把我吹醒了。
lines.en: The savanna wind woke me from the dust.

lines.zh: 我慢慢显形，先是一对耳朵。
lines.en: I fade in slowly, ears first, then the rest.

lines.zh: 幼崽跟在我身后，比我还紧张。
lines.en: The calf trails behind me, more nervous than I am.

lines.zh: 一百的权重，换一片安静的林子。
lines.en: Weight one hundred buys me one quiet grove.

lines.zh: 别围过来，刚出生的象怕吵。
lines.en: Do not crowd around; a newborn elephant fears noise.

lines.zh: 火燎到背，我转身踩灭草丛。
lines.en: Fire catches my back; I turn and stamp the grass out.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，压平一片草。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and flatten a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 水没到膝盖，我就开始往回走。
lines.en: Water reaches my knees and I start back.

lines.zh: 爆炸把土掀起来，我闭了眼。
lines.en: The blast throws soil up and I shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩头，像被蚊子叮了一口。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder is only a mosquito bite.

lines.zh: 药水味散开，我的腿有点软。
lines.en: Potion vapor spreads and my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 我饿了，树叶都显得很远。
lines.en: I am hungry, and every leaf looks far away.

lines.zh: 雷劈在象牙上，我麻了半边。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my tusk and half of me numbs.

lines.zh: 虚空拖着我，我的鼻子够不到岸。
lines.en: The void pulls me down and my trunk cannot reach the rim.
